summary: Baseline-only interaction reliability audit completed by adding intentionally strict regression tests (no production fixes). Backend baseline: 18 tests run, 11 failed (expected contract gaps). Frontend baseline: 3 tests run, 3 failed. Outputs saved to interaction_audit_before_*.txt.

critical.issue: Content-fidelity regression: substantive tokens/paths are rewritten (e.g., 'src/header.py:12'/'Mode D' mutated), and secret token remained unredacted in tested path.
Missing optional interaction object contract (signature has no interaction parameter).
Status question 'What is the status of the decision council?' still classified as council request.
Numbered factual status list with audit/error/council terms routes into B/D/E path (expected non-heavy factual route under interaction contract).
No pre-LLM contradictory-instruction guard wiring detected in router source (no request_conflict call before model/tool path).
Recurring failed tool signatures are not flagged when turns are terminal-success; scanner still only aggregates failure_reason.
scripts/interaction_gate.sh missing; .github/workflows/interaction-reliability.yml missing; no blocking predeploy invocation.

ui_bugs.issue: Review badge infers 'double-checked' from provider/council flags without interaction-backed review evidence.

integration_issues.issue: extractSuggestions(content, interaction) ignores interaction contract object and still emits quote-derived chips when suggested_actions is empty.
mapHistoryTurn does not preserve interaction object nor snake_case turn_state/continue_available/failure_mode fields.

action_items: Implement INTERACTION_CONTRACT_V1-gated interaction contract in backend+frontend without breaking legacy default-off paths.
Add pre-LLM request_conflict guard to /chat/send and ensure provider/tool spies remain untouched on conflict rejection.
Introduce optional interaction persistence and round-trip mapping in history API/UI state.
Add tool_failure_signatures persistence + recurrence scan path independent of turn success/failure and beyond first-10 tool calls.
Add blocking scripts/interaction_gate.sh and reusable workflow wiring in predeploy/deploy workflows.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/chat_helpers.py:264-291 — output/business-owner passes mutate technical literals; observed rewrite of 'src/header.py:12' and 'Mode D' during baseline run.
backend/services/chat_helpers.py:_persist_turn signature (lines ~756+) has no interaction arg; cannot store v1 interaction envelope as requested.
backend/services/mode_b_council.py:95-97 + patterns at 43-47 — council keyword still triggers factual-status phrase containing 'decision council'.
backend/services/chat_helpers.py:624-642 — classify_intent B-patterns include generic 'decision council' phrase; factual status list can be misrouted.
frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.jsx:1418-1429 — review badge gate uses `(m.council || m.provider==='mode-b-council')` instead of interaction evidence.
frontend/src/utils/chatTextUtils.js:120-137 — extractSuggestions has no interaction parameter handling.
frontend/src/utils/dateDividers.js:94-112 — mapHistoryTurn drops interaction and snake_case turn-state fields.
scripts/predeploy_gate.sh:1-110 — no interaction gate invocation; /app/scripts/interaction_gate.sh absent; reusable workflow file missing.
seed_data_creation: No customer data mutation by these new tests; temporary task_chains rows were inserted and cleaned up in test scope.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline contract tests are now present and failing by design against current implementation. Re-run: `PYTHONPATH=/app/backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_interaction_reliability_contract.py -q --tb=short` and `cd /app/frontend && npx vitest run src/utils/__tests__/interactionReliability.test.jsx`. Compare output files under /app/test_reports/interaction_audit_before_*.txt.
rca of the issue: Observed failures align with contract gaps rather than flaky infra: (1) rendering pipeline still allows semantic rewriting of technical literals and did not redact provided secret pattern in this path; (2) interaction envelope is not first-class in persistence/history mapping; (3) council/intent routing still has keyword-trigger ambiguity for factual-status prompts; (4) reviewer badge is inferred from provider/council metadata rather than explicit review evidence; (5) recurring failure scanner is tied to failure_reason and misses tool-failure telemetry on successful turns; (6) interaction deploy gate wiring artifacts are absent.
